article_disclaimer: Article states VideoCardz has not independently tested the tools; treated as data, not as evidence.
method: Each press claim checked only against public PR #9646 metadata (state, merged, merged_at, title, user, body, changed paths). No other article, blog, social post or runtime result used as verification.

basis: PR title contains [USBHUB3][USBXHCI][UCX01000] and body describes xHCI quirks/architecture; metadata establishes source-tree addition, not measured controller or device support.
claim: USB 3.0 driver stack added / support for xHCI controllers

basis: PR #9646 title and changed-file list name drivers/usb/usbhub3, drivers/usb/usbxhci and drivers/usb/ucx01000.
claim: Three drivers contributed: USBHUB3, USBXHCI, UCX01000

basis: PR merged 2026-11-06T03:29:57Z; the separate public announcement itself is outside the primary-PR-only check.
PR user.login=DarkFire01; PR metadata does not establish the personal name.
claim: Developer Justin Miller, known as DarkFire01

basis: PR metadata proves merge to master, not build artefacts, nightly composition, or release status of 0.4.16.
claim: Included in latest nightly builds / development builds rather than stable 0.4.16

basis: PR body states the stack was daily-driven on Windows 11 after replacing the USB stack; this is the author's statement, not ReactOS test evidence.
claim: Tested on Windows 11 by replacing Microsoft's USB stack; described as stable

basis: PR body says a second PR after this one and DeviceProperty support concerns USB4 host/device router drivers; no such PR state was checked here.

basis: PR body states vendor-specific workarounds and ARM32/ARM64 readiness, with the caveat that KSE support is needed before the quirks are fully enabled.

finding: Primary PR confirms the merge, the three driver paths and the author's own testing/roadmap statements. It does not confirm nightly-build inclusion, stable-release status, or ReactOS-side runtime acceptance. Press report is secondary corroboration of PR metadata, not independent verification.
